snippet.title: A Love Letter to the Golden Age of Gaming - Lumo 2 - Coming 17th October
snippet.description:
For more information visit: https://numskullgames.com/game/lumo-2/

Rewind the cassette and fall head over heels into a love letter to the trailblazing days of early ‘80s & ‘90s British videogames.
Adventure calls—grab your hat, light your staff, and leap into a world of shifting landscapes and interconnected rooms, each a meticulously designed puzzle box with dangers to dodge, precision platforming and secrets to uncover. 

Echoing the games from the 8bit era, you’ll have to explore and experiment to crack the challenges within. Hunt for collectibles, and vault through portals—some even flip the script, morphing into wild genre twists that’ll keep you on your toes.
